coverage_basis: Curated everyday coverage, not empirical coverage of user logs.
matching: Catalog only. Proposed exact aliases are not an implemented semantic matcher; no arbitrary-name detection.
safety: Artwork never establishes nutrition, portion, cooking state or allergens. Missing artwork must never block logging. Unknown foods and dishes use explicit neutral fallbacks.

icons.fallback_intent: Neutral food plate and utensil when identity is unknown; logging must remain available.
Neutral covered serving dish for unknown or mixed meals; never infer ingredients.
